Isometric view of the unit (not to scale)
General assembly and bill of materials
Assembly sequence, inspection and test plan
1. Dimensions in millimetres. Model coordinates: X along the runner axis (flow +X), Z up;
the runner axis is at Y = 0, Z = -1800.
2. General tolerances ISO 2768-mK for machined parts; ISO 13920-BF for weldments; ISO
8062-3 DCTG 10 for cast surfaces not machined.
3. Welding to EN ISO 3834-2; procedures to EN ISO 15614-1; welders to EN ISO 9606-1;
quality level B to EN ISO 5817 for load-bearing welds.
4. Corrosion protection for permanent immersion in fresh water: blast Sa 2½ (ISO 8501-1),
epoxy system for ISO 12944 class Im1, plus sacrificial anodes.
5. Masses are calculated from the model volumes, or for parts the model shows solid (hub,
bulb, duct, pylon) from its area and the wall thickness stated in the bill of materials.
6. The model's duct is a 270° cutaway for display; it is manufactured as a full 360° ring.
7. This is a teaching model: materials, processes and tolerances are typical choices for a
small hydrokinetic Kaplan unit, for learning, and are not a design. Not for construction.
In-stream Kaplan unit, Turbine Lab FreeCAD model · drawing set and process plan
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
